title: Project Overview & Configuration
description: Start by understanding the project structure, dependencies, and configuration. Learn what this Next.js workshop platform is built with and how it's configured.

title: Application Entry Point
description: Explore the root layout and home page that serve as the entry points to the application. Understand how the site is structured and how navigation works.

title: Event Data Models & Types
description: Learn the core event data structures and type definitions that define how events are represented throughout the application. This is the foundation for all event-related features.

title: Event Pages & Registration UI
description: See how events are displayed to users and how the registration flow works from the UI perspective. Understand the event detail page and registration form components.

title: Checkout & Payment Flow
description: Understand how the Stripe payment integration works, from checkout session creation to payment processing and webhook handling. This is critical for the revenue model.

title: Email System & Automation
description: Learn how confirmations, reminders, and follow-up emails are generated and sent. Understand the email templates and the automation that keeps participants engaged.

title: Database & Registration Management
description: Understand how registrations are stored and managed, including intake forms, database operations, and data validation. See how user data flows through the system.

title: Testing & Quality Assurance
description: Explore the comprehensive test suite that ensures reliability across checkout, email, registration flows, and business logic. Understand the quality gates that protect the platform.
